description: This file provides functions and types for sending messages via the LINE messaging platform, including creating various message types, handling user profiles, and managing message sending workflows.

methods.name: normalizeTarget
methods.description: Normalizes the recipient identifier for LINE messaging, removing prefixes like 'line:group:' or 'line:user:'.

methods.name: isLineUserChatId
methods.description: Checks if a chat ID corresponds to a LINE user chat ID based on its format.

methods.name: createLineMessagingClient
methods.description: Creates a LINE messaging client and resolves the associated account using provided options.

methods.name: createLinePushContext
methods.description: Prepares the context for pushing messages to a specific recipient, including account and client.

methods.name: createTextMessage
methods.description: Creates a plain text message object.

methods.name: createImageMessage
methods.description: Creates an image message object with original and preview URLs.

methods.name: createVideoMessage
methods.description: Creates a video message object with optional tracking ID.

methods.name: createAudioMessage
methods.description: Creates an audio message object with specified duration.

methods.name: createLocationMessage
methods.description: Creates a location message object with title, address, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: logLineHttpError
methods.description: Logs details of an HTTP error encountered during LINE API requests.

methods.name: recordLineOutboundActivity
methods.description: Records outbound activity for a LINE account.

methods.name: pushLineMessages
methods.description: Sends multiple messages to a recipient via LINE, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: replyLineMessages
methods.description: Replies to a message thread with specified messages.

methods.name: sendMessageLine
methods.description: Sends a message (text and optional media) to a recipient, either as a reply or push.

methods.name: pushMessageLine
methods.description: Pushes a message to a recipient without reply token.

methods.name: replyMessageLine
methods.description: Replies to a message thread with specified messages.

methods.name: pushMessagesLine
methods.description: Pushes multiple messages to a recipient with error context.

methods.name: createFlexMessage
methods.description: Creates a Flex message with alternative text and contents.

methods.name: pushImageMessage
methods.description: Pushes an image message to a recipient.

methods.name: pushLocationMessage
methods.description: Pushes a location message to a recipient.

methods.name: pushFlexMessage
methods.description: Pushes a Flex message to a recipient.

methods.name: pushTemplateMessage
methods.description: Pushes a template message to a recipient.

methods.name: pushTextMessageWithQuickReplies
methods.description: Pushes a text message with quick reply options.

methods.name: createQuickReplyItems
methods.description: Creates quick reply items from a list of labels.

methods.name: createTextMessageWithQuickReplies
methods.description: Creates a text message object with attached quick reply options.

methods.name: showLoadingAnimation
methods.description: Displays a loading animation to a chat for a specified duration.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Fetches user profile information, with caching.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of a user, falling back to user ID if unavailable.
